content: Edge repos UX: extraPackagesEdge now auto-enables enableEdgeRepos (applyImpliedFlags in LoadConfig, hard error removed from validateConfig); invalid config values no longer abort before the wizard — LoadConfig returns (conf, err) on validation errors, main.go runs the wizard pre-filled then re-validates (config.ValidateConfig) before disk work; unattended+invalid = fatal as before. Tests: config_test.go 6 subtests green.

Session apps (polkit-agent/dms/wayvnc) moved OUT of system-wide user boot.d into niri-session explicit starts (existence-filtered, after dinitctl start niri) — upstream add-wants niri.service model per niri docs + DMS docs (explicit warning: user-manager enable = starts in ALL sessions, our exact greeter bug) + turnstile README (user manager = login scope). boot.d = infrastructure only. Greeter never runs niri-session so never gets desktop apps; lifetime matches upstream (start with session, stop at teardown). dms-session greeter guard kept as belt+braces. aports niri-user-dinit r3 9838d81 CI green.

DMS theme green seeded by installer: niri.go writes ~/.config/DankMaterialShell/settings.json (currentThemeCategory=generic, currentThemeName=green) after dms setup + per-file chown (root-owned seed would block DMS settings saves). Keys from DMS source: SettingsSpec.js + ThemeColorsTab.qml; generic themes = static Material palettes, matugen only in dynamic mode.

DMS dark mode seeded by installer: session.json in ~/.local/state/DankMaterialShell (XDG state, NOT config) with isLightMode=false. Research: fresh installs already dark (SharedSessionSpec.js isLightMode def=false; PortalService.handlePortalColorScheme records first read without applying — only later transitions flip mode; ThemeAutoService off by default; syncModeWithPortal only affects matugen Go binary, not DMS mode). Seed = portal-independent guarantee; user toggles later win (DMS overwrites session.json).

DMS bar bottom seeded via migration path: installer settings.json seed = configVersion:1 + legacy dankBarAtBottom:true; DMS v1->v2 migration (SettingsStore.js migrateToVersion) builds FULL default barConfigs with position=1 Bottom on first launch. GOTCHA: SettingsStore.parse assigns arrays raw (no deep merge) — partial barConfigs seed would wipe default widgets; full-default duplication would drift with upstream. Migration path = canonical + future-proof.

DMS bar left widgets swapped: installer seed dankBarLeftWidgets=[launcherButton,workspaceSwitcher,runningApps] (focusedWindow out). Same v1->v2 migration legacy keys; per-list fallback ||defaults means only left pinned, center/right track upstream. runningApps = valid bar widget (BarWidgetCatalog, shows all running apps with focus indication).

DMS default apps seeded: xdg-terminals.list (Alacritty.desktop) + mimeapps.list [Default Applications] firefox web mimes, org.gnome.eog.desktop images, com.system76.CosmicPlayer.desktop audio. DMS Default Apps tab = freedesktop frontend (terminal via xdg-terminal-exec file, rest via DesktopService mimeapps). Alpine desktop IDs verified via pkgs.alpinelinux.org contents: eog = org.gnome.eog.desktop GOTCHA, cosmic-player = com.system76.CosmicPlayer.desktop, alacritty = Alacritty.desktop capital A.

DMS customizations complete + validated (harness 2026-10-11T12-18-06Z 94/94): green theme, dark mode (session.json XDG state), bottom bar + runningApps widget (v1->v2 migration legacy keys dankBarAtBottom/dankBarLeftWidgets), default apps (xdg-terminals.list Alacritty.desktop + mimeapps.list firefox/org.gnome.eog.desktop/com.system76.CosmicPlayer.desktop), cosmic-screenshot dropped from niri packages. All seeds freedesktop-standard or DMS-own-migration — zero default duplication. Alpine desktop ID gotcha: eog = org.gnome.eog.desktop.

pkexec refused FeralOS login-shell: pkexec validates session user shell vs /etc/shells -> unlisted login-shell path = RC 127 'SHELL variable was not found in /etc/shells' on EVERY privileged op in niri session (DMS Create User = pkexec useradd -m -s /bin/bash + head -n1 | chpasswd; isBSD branch never fires). Diagnosed live: debug_run boot, pkexec RC=127 inside session c1, root useradd RC=0 (shadow installed, /bin/bash present, /etc/shells from alpine-baselayout-data has sh/ash/bash/fish). Fix: users.go lists /usr/libexec/feralos/login-shell in /etc/shells (idempotent) — SAFE because our niri-user-dinit niri-session has NO /etc/shells bash re-exec trap (upstream Alpine script had one; that was the original reason to keep it unlisted). Harness login_shell_trick extended with the assertion.

DMS default apps maps/calendar: mimeapps seed x-scheme-handler/geo=org.gnome.Maps.desktop, text/calendar+x-scheme-handler/calendar+webcal+webcals=org.gnome.Calendar.desktop. Desktop IDs verified on Alpine pkgs contents (org.gnome reverse-DNS convention). gnome-maps + gnome-calendar packages added to niri internal_rules.

DMS icon themes fixed: adwaita-icon-theme + hicolor-icon-theme as dms-shell deps (aports 14f124b r3 CI green); installer seeds ~/.config/gtk-3.0/settings.ini with gtk-icon-theme-name=Adwaita + gtk-application-prefer-dark-theme=true. DMS icon chain: QT_QPA_PLATFORMTHEME=gtk3 -> GTK settings -> gtk-icon-theme-name (unset before = hicolor generics). Live target had breeze/hicolor/Cosmic only transitively, adwaita absent, dms.log clean in QEMU (breeze fallback) — user saw missing icons on real hw.

Harness 2026-10-11T14-56-07Z 95/95 (new baseline): dms_icons check green (adwaita-icon-theme 50.0-r1 + hicolor installed via dms-shell 1.6.2-r3 deps, /usr/share/icons/Adwaita/index.theme on disk, seeded gtk-3.0/settings.ini Adwaita) + login_shell_trick extended assertion green (/etc/shells lists login-shell — pkexec fix live). Full niri stack healthy (layers, screenshot PNG, wayvnc :5900, DMS IPC, TPM unlock). 0 ignored errors.

Nix unstable leak: stable channel nixos-26.05 was added but the flake registry pin was inside 'if len(nixPackages)>0' — enableNix without nixPackages (default since DMS went native) kept builtin nixpkgs-unstable for all nixpkgs# references; root registry never pinned. Fix: /etc/nix/registry.json system-wide (version 2, indirect nixpkgs -> github:NixOS/nixpkgs/nixos-26.05) + unconditional user registry.json pin; harness nix_registry_stable check (system file grep + nix registry list as user).

DMS power off/reboot dead under dinit root cause: DMS SessionService.qml picks loginctl (elogind detected) -> elogind run_helper executes hooks from /etc/elogind/system-shutdown THEN execlp ABSOLUTE /sbin/poweroff (busybox; build-time path, no config override) -> SIGUSR2 -> dinit ignores -> nothing. PATH bypassed so /usr/bin/dinit-shutdown wrappers useless. Fix: installer hook /etc/elogind/system-shutdown/50-feralos-dinit.sh execs /usr/sbin/dinit-{poweroff,reboot,halt} per $1. Harness dinit_shutdown_commands extended. Chain: quickshell(DMS)->loginctl->polkit allow_active->elogind->hook->dinit. Note hold-to-confirm in DMS UI (powerActionConfirm).

DMS power second finding: under dinit elogind GetSessionByPID returns NoSessionForPID (no session cgroups) -> polkit never allow_active -> login1 power actions = auth challenge/silent timeout. Fix: /etc/polkit-1/rules.d/49-feralos-power.rules (wheel -> login1 power-off/reboot/halt + multiple-sessions = YES). Discovered during live validation of the elogind hook fix (run 16-00-30Z debug: probe test-only rule needed first; hook itself proven: dinit STOPPD cascade + kernel S5).

DMS update button working: /usr/local/bin/feralos-update wired as updaterCustomCommand (DMS 1.6.2 runs it in a terminal as user, sudo prompt inside; exit code = failure signal). Sequence: apk update+upgrade --available -> flatpak conditional (unused user/system, update user/system) -> nix conditional (channel update, nix profile upgrade '.*', delete-generations +5, collect-garbage, root profile too). DMS has no apk backend. Harness dms_update_script. Caveat: 30-min DMS server timeout. system-config-printer removed from niri (DMS printer settings).

No harness check for feralos-update (user decision): running it in the VM fails on edge-package upgrades (niri stack = extraPackagesEdge, repos commented out post-install -> apk upgrade of those pkgs fails in-harness). Validation = manual on real hw. The dms_update_script check was dropped from the harness.

DMS window buttons plugin: NEW repo github.com/skea999/dms-window-buttons v1.0.0 (ISC; PluginComponent widget: maximize-to-edges/fullscreen/close for focused window via NiriService IPC + toplevel.close, hidden with no window, no minimize on niri) + aports package dms-window-buttons (b8604c1 CI green; installs /etc/xdg/quickshell/dms-plugins/dmsWindowButtons). Installer: bar back to TOP (dankBarAtBottom removed), dankBarRightWidgets pinned + plugin, plugin_settings.json seed enabled=true (bare map shape verified vs 1.6.2 parsePluginSettings; widget plugins default disabled). Harness dms_window_buttons. niri has no SSD so bar buttons are the only path for non-CSD apps.

feralos-update script write switched to ExecSilent: ExecuteCmd echoed the script body into installer.log -> harness log_errors sweep matched script words (error/FAILED/failing) = false positive (run 2026-10-11T17-45-21Z, 95/96). ExecSilent = logging-free, same pattern as firmware detection.

niri prefer-no-csd added to user config (installer niri.go): apps omit CSD titlebars (frameless, Windows-like); controls = DMS bar dms-window-buttons widget + keybinds. niri-only GLOBAL lever (no per-window rule, no DMS setting; DMS embedded config ships it active). Caveats: floating resize Mod+right-click, app restart needed.
